reason: Not refuted. Checked against the source: (1) Control flow: after a cell with Y=7, X = rows left less 1 (EOR #&FF of Y - rows_m1); CPX #8 / BCC part_byte is exactly the old .cell test with Y=7 (7 - rows_m1 >= 0 iff rows_m1 <= 7, unsigned, X 0..254), and part_byte gets the same X and Y as old LDX rows_m1; X >= 8 stores rows_m1 and re-enters .cell with Y=7 as before. C differs at part_byte (0 not 1) but part_byte and .columns/.more/.compiled never read C before setting it (CMP/CLC). Carry chain in the cell step is unchanged (TAX, ORA leave C; SBC #&02 borrows nothing since high >= &40). (2) Dropping AND #&3F: record byte 10 is written only by draw_column (line 1742) from s_ptr+1 = b_ptr+1, which every writer keeps in &40-&7F (raise_address, forward/back/flipped_in_ring, up_in_ring); kind cache records use KC_MARK &FD and compiled &FF, both BMI to .compiled; sky's rotor goes through ren_draw_sprite. &3D-&7D ORA &40 gives the same as AND/ORA, and draw_column's own next-cell code already relies on ORA #&40 alone. (3) Memory: rows_m1 = &CB (also the game's scenery_layer_flip) is not in save_game_zp/restore_game_zp; the logic writes it (get_sprite_and_flip) before reading; the prebuild walk lists &CB as written-before-read; every renderer user writes it first (.more, draw_column line 1696); credits.6502 and bank5 use &CA/&CB only on the front end, saving them. No IRQ touches it. So its stale final value is harmless. Same bank (4, ROMSEL/ACCCON unchanged), same RAM read and written (v_ptr, s_ptr pointers identical). (4) Room: applied in a scratch copy and built default, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW, SKY_HELI=0, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW+SKY_HELI=0, gameplay, and gameplay+SKY_HELI=0+DEBUG_FULLREDRAW: all assemble with every ASSERT. (SHIFT=256 SHIFTEND=1 fails on bank 5 overrun by 239, identically with HEAD's render.6502: pre-existing, unrelated.) Listing: .cell &9E4E to BRA columns &9E8A all in page &9E, no branch page-cross penalties. (5) Cycles: two-cell column (hot) old STA 3 + AND 2 + BCC 3 + TYA/SEC/SBC/BCS 10 + LDX 3 + JMP 3 = 24 vs new TAX 2 + BCC 3 + CPX 2 + BCC 3 + BRA 3 = 13 (-11); single-cell column 0 (JMP 3 = BRA 3); each further middle cell +7 (STX/BRA/CPX/BCC-not against STA/AND); INC page path saves the BRA. Measured mix ~8.5 a column is consistent. Bytes: +2 (TAX 1, CPX 2, BCC 2, STX 2, BRA 2 against STA 2, AND 2, JMP 3 to BRA 2): the claim's -2 saving.
